name: FluxTransit Profile screen
description: Design Graph of the FluxTransit Profile screen (OPUS card balance, saved routes, settings, app info), generated blind from XAML + MVUX model + style dictionary per SKILL.md v0.4.

evidence.rationale: Page declared in ProfilePage.xaml with ScrollViewer root, MaxWidth 600 content column, SafeArea insets.
Header Grid with back Button column and title StackPanel column.
Button with FluxIconButtonStyle, back-arrow FontIcon E72B, Command bound to GoBack; GoBack declared on ProfileModel.
TextBlock Text="Profile" with FluxHeadingLarge style.
TextBlock literal under the title, FluxBody style.
Three sibling sections share the identical declared structure: Border with FluxGlassPanelStyle wrapping a 16-spaced StackPanel whose first child is a FluxMicro uppercase section title.
First FluxGlassPanelStyle Border, titled OPUS CARD.
Second FluxGlassPanelStyle Border, titled SAVED ROUTES.
Third FluxGlassPanelStyle Border, titled SETTINGS.
Border commented 'Card Visual' with fixed 120x80 size, FluxPrimaryStrongBrush background, OPUS brand text and CardNumber binding (ProfileModel.CardNumber => "**** 4521").
Literal TextBlock above the balance value.

properties.format: literal '$' Run followed by bound OpusBalance Run

evidence.rationale: TextBlock with Runs '$' + {Binding OpusBalance}; ProfileModel.OpusBalance IState<decimal> initialized to 18.50.
Literal TextBlock below the balance value.

properties.commandBehavior: sets IsRefreshing true, simulates a 1s refresh, sets a new OpusBalance, sets IsRefreshing false

evidence.rationale: Button Command={Binding UpdateBalance}, FluxPrimaryButtonStyle, Visibility bound to inverse IsRefreshing; UpdateBalance declared on ProfileModel.

properties.presentation: Update Balance button collapses; a 20x20 ProgressRing plus 'Updating...' FluxBody text is shown in its place

evidence.rationale: Grid overlays button and ProgressRing row with complementary Visibility bindings on IsRefreshing; IsRefreshing IState<bool> declared on ProfileModel.
Two structurally identical FluxTransitCardStyle rows (icon + name + stations + chevron) with identical style overrides; clearly one reusable row concept.
First route Border with literal texts.
Second route Border with literal texts.
Outlined transparent Button with plus FontIcon E710 and 'Add New Route' text; no Command or handler declared.
Literal TextBlock above the API key TextBox.
TextBox Text bound TwoWay to GeminiApiKey; GeminiApiKey IState<string> declared on ProfileModel (empty default).

unresolved.question: Are the two saved-route rows placeholder literals for a future bound collection, or genuinely static content?
unresolved.reason: Route texts are XAML literals; no ItemsRepeater/ItemsControl or collection binding exists on this screen.

unresolved.question: What happens when a saved-route row is tapped?
unresolved.reason: The trailing chevron affords navigation, but no Command, Tapped handler, or Navigation.Request is declared.

unresolved.question: What does the Add New Route button do?
unresolved.reason: No Command or event handler is declared on the button; intent is only suggested by its plus icon and label.

unresolved.question: Is the language ChipGroup meant to drive ProfileModel.SelectedLanguage?
unresolved.reason: ProfileModel declares an IState<string> SelectedLanguage (default "EN"), but the ChipGroup has no binding; EN IsChecked=True is a XAML literal, so selection currently has no declared effect.

unresolved.question: What state does the Service Alerts ToggleSwitch control?
unresolved.reason: IsOn=True is a XAML literal; no binding or handler connects the toggle to any model state.

unresolved.question: How is ProfileModel.SaveSettings invoked?
unresolved.reason: The model declares a SaveSettings task reading GeminiApiKey and SelectedLanguage, but no element on this screen binds to it.

unresolved.question: Does tapping the balance/card area refresh the balance, as the 'Tap to refresh' hint implies?
unresolved.reason: No tap handler is declared on the balance area; only the Update Balance button invokes UpdateBalance.

unresolved.question: Which screen does the back button return to?
unresolved.reason: GoBack delegates to INavigator.GoBack (dynamic back stack); no static destination exists to support a navigates-to edge.

unresolved.question: Should the literal spacing values (4/8/16/24) be treated as uses of the declared FluxSpacingXS/S/M/L resources?
unresolved.reason: FluxStyles.xaml declares matching x:Double spacing resources, but this page writes the values as literals, so no resourceKey is asserted on the spacing tokens.
